channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Trump says he will raise new U.S. tariff rate from 10% to 15%
item.description: WASHINGTON >> President Donald Trump said today he will raise a temporary tariff from 10% to 15% on U.S. imports from all countries, the maximum level allowed under the law, after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down his previous tariff program.

item.title: Businesses celebrate tariff relief, and brace for new uncertainty
item.description: Companies across the country welcomed the Supreme Court’s ruling Friday with jubilation and a collective exhale after months of anxious waiting. Suddenly, it seemed, they were freed from the burden of punishing import taxes.

item.title: 2 men on moped seriously injured after crash in Waikiki
item.description: Two men were seriously injured after the moped they were riding rear-ended another vehicle on Royal Hawaiian Avenue in Waikiki Friday afternoon, police said.

item.title: Hawaii baseball game against Wichita State postponed
item.description: Today’s University of Hawaii baseball game against Wichita State scheduled for 3:05 p.m. at Les Murakami Stadium has been postponed due to poor weather conditions.

item.title: Police investigate Tantalus lookout gunpoint robbery
item.description: Honolulu police are seeking two male suspects who robbed a man and a woman Friday night at the Tantalus lookout

item.title: Mapunapuna gym owner exchanges gunfire with armed suspects
item.description: A Mapunapuna gym owner exchanged gunfire with armed suspects who entered his business early this morning, police said.

item.title: Hawaii closes out UC Santa Barbara for its 10th win in 11 games
item.description: Imani Perez scored a team-high 14 points and Saniyah Neverson posted the second double-double of her Hawaii career with 13 points and 12 rebounds to lead the Rainbow Wahine to a big 58-52 win over UC Santa Barbara today at the Thunderdome in Santa Barbara, Calif.

item.title: Wahiawa woman, 66, missing for 2 weeks
item.description: CrimeStoppers and Honolulu police are asking the public for help in finding a missing 66-year-old Wahiawa woman, who needs daily medication.

item.title: Hawaii island girl, 3, killed after being struck by SUV in parking lot
item.description: A 3-year-old Waikoloa girl was killed Friday evening after being struck by a reversing SUV in a parking lot, Hawaii island police said.

item.title: OT win on AC’s night lifts Rainbows into first-place tie
item.description: Isaiah Kerr scored six points in overtime, including the go-ahead three-point play with 1:59 to go, to boost Hawaii to a pulsating 78-75 victory over UC Santa Barbara at Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center.
